test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Reflected ray passes through principal focus when incident ray ___________.

options.text: is parallel to principal axis of concave mirror
is passing through C of convex mirror
is parallel to principal axis of convex mirror
is incident at the pole of plane mirror

solution:
The correct answer is **parallel to the principal axis of the concave mirror.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Concave mirror**

__
 
• The reflective surface of a concave mirror is curled inward and away from the light source.
 
• Light is reflected inward to a single focal point via concave mirrors.
 
• A concave mirror, also known as a converging mirror, has an inwardly depressed reflecting surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e8c49b04fef2fabfeb82ac9fd8167f0b0ced703eda19a4e1cef1bdde31f826c.png] 

 In the case of **concave mirrors**, rays parallel to the principal axis converge and meet at the **focus**.
